name: Portable Handheld Turbo Fan
description:
4-in-1 Multi-Purpose Handheld Fan :  Flat grip design that fits your palm, classic and stylish handheld fan As a neckhanging fan, the unique design of adjustable angle allows you to easily adjust the wind direction, for blowing directly the air to the body or face 180-degree damping folding design, after 90-degree folding, as a desktop fan can be stably placed flat on desktop; after 180-degree folding, it can be fully stored and easily put in a pocke
5000mAh, 4-22 Hours : High-capacity polymer rechargeable lithium battery, 5000mAh, up to 22 hours continuous working time when working at low wind speed, 4 hours when working at maximum wind speed
Power display : Clear LED digital indicate the power level, allowing you to know the remaining power at all times, preventing insufficient power when outdoor active
Five Wind Speed Levels with Adjustable Noise : For indoor use, we recommend Levels 1-2: Adequate airflow Noise below 35 dB (library-quiet environment) For outdoor scenarios, opt for Levels 3-5: Powerful airflow performance Level 5 delivers maximum wind force (note: noticeable noise at this setting)
Powerful Fan : with a maximum speed of 12500 rpm, 3.6m/s, can quickly provide a huge amount of air to achieve cooling down.
